description: This file is a JUnit test class for testing utility functions related to user-created bookshelves in the Book Project. It sets up test data, interacts with services, and verifies behaviors such as retrieving books from custom shelves.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing utility functions related to UserCreatedShelf in the Book Project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, creating shelves and associating books.

methods.name: resetServices
methods.description: Resets the book and shelf services by deleting all existing entries.

methods.name: createSetOfBooks
methods.description: Creates a set of two books with given titles, associated with specified shelves.

methods.name: createAndSaveBook
methods.description: Creates a new Book object with given title, predefined shelf, and user shelf, then saves it.

methods.name: addBooksToCustomShelves
methods.description: Adds books to custom shelves based on a predefined 'to read' shelf.

methods.name: saveCustomShelves
methods.description: Saves multiple UserCreatedShelf objects via the service.

methods.name: returnBooksSuccessfully
methods.description: Test method to verify retrieval of books from a custom shelf.

methods.name: returnNoBooksIfNoBooksInCustomShelf
methods.description: Test method to verify behavior when a shelf contains no books.

methods.name: returnNoBooksForNonExistentCustomShelf
methods.description: Test method to verify behavior when querying a non-existent shelf.
